main_text.p: χαίρω, id est χαίρω gaudeo, χεχαρηκὼς gavisus: ab ἔχηκα (quod Dorice est ἔσχακα) ἐσχὼς stans: sic πεπληγὼς attonitus, pavens, à πλήσσω sive πλήγμι. Quandoque contractis inferitur ε, ut ἑστὼς ἑστῶτος, ἑστὸς ἑστεῶτος. Itaque quadrupliciter id participium effertur: τεθνηκὼς, τεθναὼς, τεθνὼς, τεθνεὼς.
Ultima participii masculini activi, vel ex ω vel ex μι, longa est: fœminini & neutri incontracti, est brevis, excepto futuro 2.
main_text.head: Cap. 17. De passivo praesenti triplici.

page.notes: Greek and Hebrew-like forms transcribed as far as legible; several Greek words in the top lines are blurred by stains and may contain errors. The heading "Cap. 17." is set in italic and spaced type.
